question: Consider a system of $N$ identical point charges $+q$ placed at the vertices of a regular polygon of $N$ sides. The distance of each vertex from the center is $R$. The net electric field at the center is zero due to symmetry. If one of the charges is removed, analyze the superposition of the remaining fields to determine the magnitude of the new net electric field at the center.

options.D: It depends on whether N is even or odd.
